features.name: SFTP client in Business Central
features.description: A new SFTP client capability in Business Central's system application that allows direct file transfer without requiring Azure functions as a proxy.
caveats: Supports both password and private key authentication

features.name: SFTP code unit methods
features.description: The SFTP client code unit provides methods including add fingerprint, initialize, list files, get file as stream, file exist, delete file, disconnect, put file, set working directory, is connected, and create directory.

features.name: SSH fingerprint verification
features.description: The SFTP client supports server fingerprint verification as part of the SSH connection negotiation, allowing clients to verify the identity of the remote server.

features.name: Private key authentication for SFTP
features.description: SFTP file transfers can be authenticated using private and public key pairs instead of passwords, which is common for bank uploads.

features.name: SFTP operation response structure
features.description: The SFTP code unit returns operation responses with a similar structure to Azure blob storage code units, allowing consistent error handling and response checking.
